note: Compared text block by block and structure by structure, enlarging all three figures. On the specific question asked: the curved mechanism arrows in the acetanilide resonance scheme ARE present and correct - both of them, the arrow from the nitrogen lone pair to the N-C bond and the arrow from the C=O pi bond up to oxygen, with the lone-pair dots, the negative charge on O and the positive charge on N in the right-hand canonical form. Nothing is missing anywhere on the page: both schemes keep every structure, every reagent above and below its arrow ((CH3CO)2O/Pyridine, Br2/CH3COOH, OH- or H+), the 1/2/3 ring numbering on 4-bromoaniline, and all green Br / magenta NH2 colour coding. The folio 'Chemistry 272' is present and prints the number once, in its yellow box.
